translate_en|mods/EatSmart/42.15/media/l: When enabled, calorie and protein options don't show up if you don't have the Nutritionist trait.
Adds an option to eat just enough food to reach your custom Calories value, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled.
Custom Calories value to reach, if possible.
Adds an option to eat enough food to reach the maximum Calories value the character can have: 3700 Calories.

Adds an option to eat enough food to reach the Calories threshold where the character starts gaining weight. <LINE>This threshold depends on weight and metabolism traits. <LINE>The option intentionally consumes 5 extra Calories so the weight-gain arrows can appear briefly in the character info panel.
Adds an option to eat just enough food to reach 0⁒ Hunger, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled.

Adds an option to eat just enough food to reach your custom Hunger value, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled. <LINE>0⁒ means not hungry, 100⁒ means starving. <LINE>Vanilla Hunger moodle levels start around 15⁒, 25⁒, 45⁒, and 70⁒ hunger.
Custom Hunger value to reach, if possible.

Adds an option to eat just enough food to reach your custom Proteins value, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled. <LINE>Vanilla Strength XP gains a x1.5 multiplier when Proteins are above 50 and below 300. <LINE>Vanilla Strength XP gets a x0.7 multiplier when Proteins are below -300.
Custom Proteins value to reach, if possible.
Adds an option to consume just enough food to reach 0⁒ Thirst, if possible. <LINE>If the goal is already met or the selected food is not enough, the option will be disabled.
